column1: # Curated HARD / MEDIUM real-world redaction cases for the bench (#1185).
# Each row is a (file, term) pair chosen so the term lives in a structure that
# makes CORRECT redaction hard — likely to leak in a carrier a tool doesn't
# scrub, or to corrupt/destabilise output. Unlike a corpus scan the term is
# CHOSEN, not sampled. Referenced PDFs are the gitignored corpora; absent files
# --- HARD: term lives in a carrier beyond ordinary page content ---
